text_blocks.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
text_blocks.text: I think both teams, Utah and Washington, they have a deep enough roster that if they add me, that we can automatically be a playoff team. And that rookie year, obviously.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on handling the pressure of being a top prospect
quotes.excerpt: I've been number one my whole life. So I kind of just grew up in the spotlight.
quotes.quote: It's more so inspired. I've been number one my whole life. So I kind of just grew up in the spotlight. So I just been hooping. Expectations are going to be on me, but I mean, I can mess up a couple times, but I'm going to just keep going, I'm going to keep hooping.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on what he expects from a potential NBA team
quotes.excerpt: I think they will ask me to come in, make a defensive impact but also be a leader
quotes.quote: I think they will ask me to come in, make a defensive impact but also be a leader at a young age and just kind of be, I mean, I would say they have vets over there, they have AD over there, they have Draymond over there, but I think they want a young, a young and hungry team that, you know, can go score the ball, paint transition. I think they know all that.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the expectations for AJ Dybantsa as a franchise player
quotes.excerpt: They want to revive that area. They want to bring back what that culture is in that area
quotes.quote: They want a franchise player, right? They want to revive that area. They want to bring back what that culture is in that area to that organization. And I'm only saying that because you will be the number one pick. I believe that. And as of right now, Washington has that pick. So what they need is you. They need somebody that they can put this organization behind AJ for the next decade, right? This is how they're looking at this. Can we put this organization behind AJ for the next decade? And that's what you're going to be coming into because AD is not going to be there. I mean, he's getting older. Trey is kind of reaching his moment and this is going to be a major, major year for Trey that I think.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his growth and learning to deal with losing
quotes.excerpt: I've been in teams and situations where I haven't been winning. I haven't won a championship since
quotes.quote: I've been in teams and situations where I haven't been winning. I haven't won a championship since, besides my gold medals, I haven't won a championship since like my freshman year of high school. So I've been in, I'm not going to say losing organizations, but I've been losing. I lost in the first round last year. I didn't win Big 12. I didn't win my senior year to make it to Chipotle Nationals. So I have to keep finding ways to win and win and win. So when I'm at my peak, I'll be winning, rather than me winning now. And then when I'm losing, I don't know how to deal with losing.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his rate of improvement
quotes.excerpt: My rate of improvement throughout the season is actually like ridiculous.
quotes.quote: My rate of improvement throughout the season is actually like ridiculous. Like the first game, if you watch my first game reads versus my last game reads, it's night and day, especially the film I'm watching. I was only 35 games, so that's half a season. So imagine if you give me 82 games to just watch film and I have a coach dedicated to watch film with me, unlimited gym access. Yeah, like, you know, those are going to be the smaller wins for me. Like in the beginning of the season, okay, you're averaging 15, five and five. At the end of the season, you're averaging 26 and seven. You know, it's just, those are small wins for me.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on when he started to take basketball seriously
quotes.excerpt: I was probably like 14, working out with 18, 19 year olds getting beat up.
quotes.quote: I was probably like 14, working out with 18, 19 year olds getting beat up. I grew five inches that summer, came back, they let me play varsity as an eighth grader, started getting busy. It was my eighth grade coach Joe Saunders.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his work ethic and being a teammate
quotes.excerpt: I'm super unselfish. I probably I think I averaged five assists this year.
quotes.quote: I'm super unselfish. I probably I think I averaged five assists this year. So like me, I could just shoot like 20 shots and not pass, but it's the game's more fun when everybody eat. I want to I want to see everybody eat.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on AJ Dybantsa's ability to elevate teammates
quotes.excerpt: His greatest skill set is being able to implement him into other great players.
quotes.quote: I think that's his greatest skill set right now. He got all the skills, but like his greatest skill set is being able to implement him into other great players, right? And him still be able to do what he do in the midst of all the other great players, because you don't have to, he don't have to rely on one skill set. Because his motor, it sets that separates you. I keep going back to that. That separates you. And now you add the skill set, 6'9, and handle, can shoot, can post, it's going to look better in the NBA than it did in college.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his advice for handling the draft process
quotes.excerpt: You don't know what's about to happen. You're going to go through every emotion
quotes.quote: You don't know what's about to happen. You're going to go through every emotion that you can possibly go through when it comes to dealing with hearing your name as the number one pick. So you're going to go through that. I told them off camera, man, it's just, there's so much stress on what he have, like that, that crown is heavy. You know, and it could get heavy for anybody, but let alone a 19 year old. So just enjoy it, like have fun. The season ain't here yet.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his goal for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: My number one goal is to not only make the playoffs, go far in the playoffs.
quotes.quote: My number one goal is to not only make the playoffs, go far in the playoffs. I think both teams, Utah and Washington, they have a deep enough roster that if they add me, that we can automatically be a playoff team.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his plan to finish his degree
quotes.excerpt: I told her if I go to the NBA after one year, I'll graduate online.
quotes.quote: I'm going to do it online. So I told her if I go to the NBA after one year, I'll graduate online.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on when he started to simplify his game
quotes.excerpt: Going into my third season was when I I had to slow down in order to simplify
quotes.quote: Going into my third season was when I I had to slow down in order to simplify the game. My first two years, I used to get, hey man, slow down, man. You running motherfuckers over, man. Slow down. I got all of that. But then the second year I came back, it was a little bit more refined, but I still had to find, figure out whatever that pace for that season was. By the time the third season came, I was so relentless on like just doing this move 40 minutes. I start, that's when I started four spots and just working out of four spots. And I was just relentless with just spots and spots and spots. And mirroring left, what I can do right, and vice versa.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on the Spurs' comeback against the Wizards
quotes.excerpt: I think they were shooting too many threes too early in the shot clock.
quotes.quote: I think they were shooting too many threes too early in the shot clock. I would never be a coach, but if I was a coach, I would just tell them to slow down a little bit.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his parents' influence on his work ethic
quotes.excerpt: I have two immigrant, my mom's from Jamaica, my dad's from Congo. Both came here
quotes.quote: I have two immigrant, my mom's from Jamaica, my dad's from Congo. Both came here and was just working to raise three kids. So I think it was kind of inherited in us. All three of them, both my sisters work hard too, so it's kind of just in us to work hard.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his patience with coaches
quotes.excerpt: I can take all types of criticism, so like my high school coaches they were like yelling
quotes.quote: I can take all types of criticism, so like my high school coaches they were like yelling at me and I'm from Boston, so the East Coast just grilling you, but I can take that. But KY NBA coach, super chill. If you're not going to do what you got to do, you're out. And I know how to deal with that. So I mean it don't really matter, whatever coach I think I'm going to be on with it.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his relatability to the youth
quotes.excerpt: I'm super relatable to this the youth. Obviously me being in the EYBL circuit
quotes.quote: I'm super relatable to this the youth. Obviously me being in the EYBL circuit and me being in the prep school circuit. A lot of people just like me and they be curious to see what I be doing off the court, on the court. So I just be vlogging, bro.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his reaction to losing
quotes.excerpt: I had a vlog coming out for the for the NTAA game, but we lost. I was like
quotes.quote: I had a vlog coming out for the for the NTAA game, but we lost. I was like, I can't this can't go out. That's my point. That was my point though.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.excerpt: I'm a winner die like if it's a Jalen Brunson situation, I'm not drawing up a like
quotes.quote: I'm a winner die like if it's a Jalen Brunson situation, I'm not drawing up a like, I'm a winner die with your ISO game. Like I'll be a horrible coach because I'm not pleasing everybody either.
